node.statement: By (1.6), K is the maximum of finitely many finite real numbers and includes the entry 1, so K is finite and K>=1. By (1.7), rho_fac is the minimum of the four positive radii established in node 1.2.3, hence rho_fac>0. Since K>=1, (24*K)^(-1)>0; therefore (1.8) makes eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}>0.
